label: Game Start — Age Clock Set
description: Adjust the in-game or device clock by +2 years before beginning (protagonist is unknown age, assumed 11).

label: Los Platos — First Wild Pokémon
description: First encounter area. Catch 2 wild Pokémon of your desired first-team species to begin breeding.

label: First Battle vs. Nemona
description: Tutorial mandatory battle. Pikuach nefesh applies if unprepared; prepare in advance where possible.

label: Academy Enrollment
description: Beginning of the Treasure Hunt. Set goal: defeat 8 gyms, 5 Titans, 5 Team Star bases.

label: Cortondo Gym — Bug Badge
description: Katy (Bug type). Prepare team accordingly.

label: Artazon Gym — Grass Badge
description: Brassius (Grass type).

label: Levincia Gym — Electric Badge
description: Iono (Electric type). Reminder: electric moves are permitted.

label: Cascarrafa Gym — Water Badge
description: Kofu (Water type).

label: Medali Gym — Normal Badge
description: Larry (Normal type).

label: Montenevera Gym — Ghost Badge
description: Ryme (Ghost type). Use Nacli line with Purifying Salt. Purify in nearest lake or ocean after.

label: Alfornada Gym — Psychic Badge
description: Tulip (Psychic type). No psychic-type offensive moves on your team allowed.

label: Glaseado Gym — Ice Badge
description: Grusha (Ice type).

label: Stony Cliff Titan — Klawf
description: First Titan. Arven path begins.

label: Open Sky Titan — Bombirdier
description: Second Titan.

label: Lurking Steel Titan — Orthworm
description: Third Titan.

label: Quaking Earth Titan
description: Fourth Titan. Paldean Quaking Earth Titan.

label: False Dragon Titan
description: Fifth Titan. Final herba mystica.

label: Team Star Dark Crew
description: Dark-type themed base. Your Pokémon must not use dark moves. Use Nacli to counter.

label: Team Star Fire Crew
description: Fire-type themed base.

label: Team Star Poison Crew
description: Poison-type themed base. No poisoning moves.

label: Team Star Fairy Crew
description: Fairy-type themed base. Fairy offensive moves forbidden on your side.

label: Team Star Fighting Crew
description: Fighting-type themed base.

label: Pokémon League — Elite Four
description: All four Elite Four members. Prepare for Ghost types (Rika's Earth type should be fine; check each member's team).

label: Champion Battle — Nemona
description: Final Champion battle. Prepare thoroughly — mandatory battle with full rules in force.

label: The Way Home — AI Turo / Sada
description: Story climax. Mandatory battle; pikuach nefesh rules apply if necessary.

label: Post-Game Begins
description: Complete the story. Continue to any optional post-game content.
